description_en: Modifies the log status of a protected object
description_zh: 修改防护对象日志状态
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-resource-log-status --instance-id waf-cn-zz11zcl0000 --resource alb-wewbb23dfsetetcic1242-00000 --status true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyResourceLogStatus

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The log enabling status of the protected object. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Not enabled
parameters.help_zh:
防护对象日志开启状态。取值：

true：表示已开启。

false：表示未开启
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The Tracing Analysis status. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled.

To enable Tracing Analysis, you must first enable the log status Status for the protected object
parameters.help_zh:
链路追踪状态。取值：

true：表示开启。

false：表示关闭。

开启链路追踪需要开启防护对象日志Status
parameters.name: trace_status

fields.help_en: The per-mille sampling rate for Tracing Analysis
fields.help_zh: 链路追踪千分位采样率
fields.name: rate_per_mille
